findings: The dated official guide confirms 60 EC each year. The six successive language courses support linguistic and cultural study. The 30 EC Italian university semester occurs in the second half of year two and requires eligible Italian-taught coursework related to the programme. The separate 30 EC elective space keeps the ordinary and exception credit caps for first-year courses. No host course is invented. The diagnostic and repeated tutoring carry zero credit.

The dated translation entry requires the Italian proficiency sequence. The modern Italy and national-identity courses study Italy since unification with substantial cultural and political inquiry, and the cinema course analyses Italian cinema and public identity. The final 12 EC thesis follows all compulsory components and uses academic Italian.

The repaired regional trial builds relevant historical, political and artistic methods, and the literary/media trial adds textual, cultural and linguistic analysis. Film analysis and broad literary interpretation do not establish a corpus of Italian cinema or literature, and general linguistics and stylistics do not sustain Italian linguistic inquiry or translation. Two feasible trials therefore fail the academic match gate, independently of offerings.
